answer: An agent economy can make reputation portable only after an agent completes a costly, publicly verifiable task and posts a bond that is slashed if later evidence shows fraud. For example, a tundra mapping job might require several independent agents to submit overlapping terrain measurements; a terrace plan or ember alert can then be checked against the same record. A sybil operator can still create many identities, but must fund each bond and do real work, while colluding identities that certify one another risk losing their stake.
